usedFor: Cal ID holds the bookings, and MSG91 sends a confirmation through “Send Template SMS” when “Booking Created” runs.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal ID, then “Send Template SMS” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A new booking triggers a confirmation SMS from a chosen template, sent through your MSG91 account.

watchOut: A text goes out through your MSG91 account, so check the template variables match what “Booking Created” carries.
